areas.name: base64_invalid_error_reason

areas.name: base64_iolist_whitespace_and_byte_range
areas.reason: base64.erl accepts nested iolist() inputs, rejects out-of-range byte list elements (>255), and rejects whitespace in decode/1,2 per @doc unlike OTP

areas.name: calendar_date_range_guards
areas.reason: calendar enforces Year >= 0, M in 1..12, D in 1..31 guards per calendar.erl -spec rather than accepting out-of-range components like OTP

areas.name: calendar_negative_subsecond_system_time
areas.reason: calendar:system_time_to_universal_time/2 truncates negative sub-second inputs toward zero instead of floor-dividing like OTP

areas.name: array_module_unimplemented

expressions: A = array:new(), W = array:set(2, hello, A), {array:get(2, W), array:size(W), array:set(2, world, W) =:= array:set(2, world, A)}
A = array:from_list([10,20,30]), {array:is_array(A), array:size(A), array:get(1, A), array:to_list(A)}
